messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: INC-2026 — router-proxy latency p95 > 1200ms in us-west-2. Alert rule: proxy_latency_p95 > 1000ms for 2m. No customer 5xx spike flagged by SLO monitor yet. PD link: https://pd.example/INC-2026

pagerduty: Page routed to oncall schedule (rotation: eng-oncall). Escalation: primary -> primary-1h -> eng-lead.

Sasha: acked. I'm on it.

Ingrid: here. pulling dashboards, give me a sec.

Sasha: quick check — looking at router-proxy CPU and tail latencies. I see a cluster of pods at very high CPU, and a couple OOM-killed pods from earlier. autoscaler didn't add capacity, maybe hit max surge?

Matt: might be autoscaler eviction/backoff. Could also be a spike in KV cache misses. Any recent rollout?

Sasha: not that I see. last deploy ~3h ago. Running quick `kubectl top` now:
```
Sasha: kubectl top pods -l app=router-proxy --namespace=prod
Sasha: router-proxy-7f6c   1900m CPU   1.2Gi MEM
Sasha: router-proxy-9b3d   1850m CPU   1.1Gi MEM
Sasha: router-proxy-2a1e   250m CPU    300Mi MEM
```

Ingrid: that one pod (2a1e) looks healthy but 2 pods pegged. Could be uneven request distribution. Any sticky routing changes?

Leila: No sticky routing changes from frontend. I can check LB logs.

Sasha: quick mitigation: scale up replicas and add a rolling restart to rebalance connections. Doing: `kubectl scale deploy/router-proxy --replicas=6 -n prod`

Matt: sg. Also warn downstream teams about potential brief increased latencies during restart.

Sasha: executed. Command output: `scaled deployment/router-proxy to 6`

Ingrid: watching latency graph — p95 dropping already from 1300ms -> 720ms within 60s. Nice.

Leila: LB logs show spike around request fanout to model-serving; a couple of model nodes were slow, causing queueing at proxy. No 5xx.

Sasha: good. I'll also trigger a small KV-cache prefill to reduce cold misses for a hot prefix set.

Sasha: running prefill job: `redwood-cli cache prefill --prefix=recent-queries --region=us-west-2`

incidentbot: Note: PagerDuty alert INC-2026 status changed: acknowledged by Sasha at 4332109930.

Ingrid: we're seeing p95 ~450ms now. No customer SLO alerts. Good sign.

Matt: recommend leaving scaled replicas for 15m and then evaluate. If autoscaler still not reacting, raise config change.

Leila: will follow up with model infra to investigate the slow nodes.

Sasha: handing to Ingrid for a 30m watch. I'll stay reachable if it flutters back.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: INC-2026 auto-resolved at 4332110026 — alert condition cleared (latency p95 below threshold). No escalations required.

Ingrid: thanks — marking as no-customer-impact but follow-up with model infra + autoscaler config. I'll post a short postmortem summary in #incidents if anything substantive is found.

Sasha: quick action items:
- Ingrid: 30m watch + postmortem note
- Matt: check autoscaler config and surge limits, file PR if needed
- Leila: follow up with model infra on slow node cause

Leila: on it.

Sasha: closing thread from oncall side since PD auto-resolved. Leaving notes in pager: `mitigation: scaled router-proxy ->6; prefilling KV cache; no customer 5xx; follow-ups assigned`. :white_check_mark:

Ingrid: thumbs up.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026 closed (auto-resolve)."
